scope: Matched-window background-writer analysis; no runtime, policy, model or frozen V22 registration change
semantics: Use each writer snapshot timestamp, not the opportunity producer timestamp, to difference completed processing samples.
Report missing or incomplete writer evidence as unavailable, never as zero cost.
Preserve sample counts, thread CPU and wall totals without multiplying by 64 or using cumulative maxima as window maxima.
This analysis is ready for V22 collection; V21 has no writer timings and establishes neither writer CPU attribution nor improved performance.
